# OnlineHotelier

> Practical guides, calculators and services for Indian hotel owners and managers: OTA distribution, revenue management, compliance and daily operations. All figures are in Indian rupees and reflect Indian market conditions.

OnlineHotelier helps independent and small-chain hotels in India get more direct bookings and depend less on OTA commission. Guides cover the major Indian channels (MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb) and Indian regulation (GST, TDS/TCS, Form C).

## Start Here

- [OnlineHotelier - Your Guide to Getting Your Hotel Online in India](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/): OTAs, direct bookings, channel managers and hotel software explained for Indian hoteliers. 57 free guides, 11 calculators, and hands-on help choosing what fits.
- [About OnlineHotelier Insights - Free Hotel Tools for Indian Hoteliers](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/about/): OnlineHotelier Insights provides free revenue management tools and educational guides for Indian hotel owners. Learn about our mission to help hotels maximize profitability.
- [Hotel Guides - Revenue Management, OTA & Software Tutorials](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/): Comprehensive guides for Indian hoteliers covering OTA optimization, revenue management strategies, and hotel software tutorials. Learn to maximize your hotel's profitability.
- [Services for Hotels, Homestays & Vacation Rentals](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/services/): Professional services for Indian hotels, homestays and vacation rentals. OTA listing setup with Google Business Profile, and hotel website building from ₹15,000.
- [Free Hotel Tools - Revenue Calculator, OTA Commission Calculator](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/tools/): Free hotel revenue management tools for Indian hoteliers. Calculate OTA commissions, set dynamic pricing, and plan seasonal rates. No signup required.

## OTA Guides

- [OTA Guides for Indian Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/): Practical OTA guides for Indian independent hotels. Learn how to list on MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Agoda, and more. Compare commissions, boost visibility, and reduce OTA dependency.
- [Attract International Guests to Your Hotel](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/attract-international-guests-india.html): Most Indian hotels are invisible to foreign tourists. Learn which OTA to list on by country. Expedia, Agoda, Trip.com. And use geo-boost to get found first.
- [Best OTAs for Homestays in India: Airbnb vs Booking](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/best-ota-for-homestays.html): Airbnb charges just 3% host commission vs 15 to 18% on Booking.com. See which OTA works best for Indian homestays, vacation rentals, and unique stays.
- [Top 10 OTAs in India for Hotels: 2026 Guide](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/best-ota-for-hotels.html): Which OTA gives Indian hotels the most bookings? Compare the top 10 OTA platforms in India, their commission rates, and who each one is best for.
- [Best OTAs for Resorts in India: 2026 Guide](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/best-ota-for-resorts.html): Resorts need different OTAs than city hotels. See which platforms drive leisure bookings for Indian beach, hill station, and wellness resorts: with commission rates.
- [Booking.com for Hotels: Setup, Extranet & No-Shows](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/booking-com-hotel-listing-guide.html): List your hotel on Booking.com correctly from day one. Covers pay-at-hotel model, how to mark no-shows, avoid account suspension, and rank higher in search.
- [Booking.com Visibility Booster: Worth It?](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/booking-com-visibility-booster.html): Visibility Booster bumps your hotel up in search for a higher commission. See exactly how it works, what it costs, and when it's worth turning on for Indian hotels.
- [Booking.com Genius Program: Is It Worth It?](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/booking-genius-program.html): Genius gives travellers 10 to 25% off and your hotel higher visibility. Is the discount worth the trade? An honest breakdown for Indian hotels.
- [Google Free Booking Links: Get Direct Bookings Free](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/google-free-booking-links.html): Google shows your hotel's direct rates in Search and Maps: for free. Find out how to set it up, which booking engines are eligible, and how many direct bookings to expect.
- [Hotel Direct Booking Strategy for Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/hotel-direct-booking-strategy.html): Stop paying 15 to 25% OTA commission on every booking. A step-by-step direct booking strategy to help Indian hotels earn more from their own website.
- [MakeMyTrip Hotel Listing Guide for Indian Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/makemytrip-hotel-listing.html): List your hotel on MakeMyTrip step by step. Registration, photos, pricing, commission structure, and tips to maximise bookings from India's largest OTA.
- [OTA Full Form for Hoteliers: What It Costs You](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/ota-hotel-meaning.html): OTA means Online Travel Agency. For hotel owners: what MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and Booking.com actually charge you, and when an OTA booking beats a direct one.
- [What is GDS? Global Distribution System for Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/what-is-gds.html): GDS connects your hotel to travel agents and corporate bookers worldwide. Learn how Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport work, and if Indian hotels really need it.
- [What is an OTA? Online Travel Agency Guide](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/ota/what-is-ota.html): OTAs like Booking.com and MakeMyTrip charge 15 to 20% commission. Know how they work, which Indian OTAs matter, and how to use them without losing margin.

## Revenue Management

- [Hotel Revenue Management Guides for India](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/): Revenue management guides for Indian independent hotels. Learn ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, rate plans, BAR pricing, and how to increase your hotel revenue.
- [ADR Full Form in Hotel: Average Daily Rate Guide](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/adr.html): ADR full form in hotel is Average Daily Rate: revenue per occupied room per night. Formula, India benchmarks by category, and how to tell if your ADR is right.
- [ARR Full Form in Hotel: Average Room Rate Guide](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/arr.html): ARR is India's version of ADR: your average revenue per room sold. Learn the formula, see ₹ examples by hotel type, and find out how to improve your ARR.
- [BAR in Hotels: Best Available Rate Explained](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/bar.html): BAR is the lowest public rate you offer, and every other rate flows from it. Learn how to set BAR dynamically and stop leaving revenue on the table.
- [Hotel Rate Plans: EP, CP, MAP, AP on OTAs](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/hotel-rate-plans.html): Set up EP, CP, MAP and AP rate plans on MakeMyTrip and Booking.com. Pricing formulas, RO BB HB FB codes, GST rules and commission maths for Indian hotels.
- [How to Increase Hotel Revenue in India 2026](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/increase-hotel-revenue.html): Proven revenue tactics for Indian hotel owners: direct bookings, OTA benchmarking, smarter rate plans, source market gaps and daily metrics to grow revenue in 2026.
- [Hotel Booking Lead Time: What It Is & How to Use](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/lead-time.html): Lead time is how far in advance guests book. Indian OTA travellers book 7 to 21 days out. Knowing your window helps you price smarter and fill rooms faster.
- [MLOS in Hotels: Minimum Length of Stay Explained](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/mlos.html): MLOS forces guests to book 2+ nights: protecting your peak dates from single-night fillers. Learn when to use it and how to set it on Booking.com and MMT.
- [MTD & YTD in Hotels: What They Mean & How to Use](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/mtd-ytd.html): MTD tracks this month's revenue so far. YTD tracks the full year. See a real ₹ example of how Indian hotel owners use these numbers to catch problems early.
- [Hotel No-Show Meaning, Policy & Charges in India](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/no-show.html): A no-show is a guest with a confirmed booking who never arrives. How to set a no-show charge, India benchmark rates by property type, and 7 ways to cut no-shows.
- [Hotel Occupancy Rate: Formula & Benchmarks](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/occupancy.html): Occupancy = rooms sold ÷ rooms available × 100. Find out what a healthy rate looks like for Indian hotels. And why 100% is not always the goal.
- [Hotel Overbooking: Why It Happens & How to Manage](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/overbooking.html): Hotels overbook on purpose: because cancellations are predictable. Learn the right overbooking buffer for Indian properties and how to handle a walk gracefully.
- [Rate Linkage in Hotels: Manage All Rates From One](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/rate-linkage.html): Rate linkage means change your BAR once and all OTA, corporate, and discount rates update automatically. Stop managing 10 rates manually: here's how it works.
- [RevPAR Explained: Formula, Benchmarks & Tips](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/revpar.html): RevPAR = ADR × Occupancy. A 30-room hotel at ₹4,000 rate and 75% fill earns ₹3,000 RevPAR. See what's good for your city and how to push it higher.
- [Room Night in Hotels: Meaning & Why It Matters](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/room-night.html): One room, one night = one room night. A 30-room hotel at 80% occupancy sells 720 room nights a month. See how this number drives every revenue calculation.
- [TRevPAR & GOP PAR Explained for Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/revenue/trevpar.html): Learn TRevPAR and GOP PAR: two advanced hotel revenue metrics. See formulas, benchmarks, and how Indian hotels use them to measure total revenue and profit.

## Hotel Software

- [Hotel Software Guides: PMS, Channel Manager, Booking Engine](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/): Plain-English guides to hotel software for Indian independent hoteliers. PMS, channel manager, booking engine, RMS, POS, and accounting software explained.
- [Hotel Booking Engine: Accept Direct Bookings Online](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/booking-engine.html): A booking engine on your own website earns the same booking at zero OTA commission. See how to set one up, which engines work for Indian hotels, and what it costs.
- [Channel Manager for Hotels: What It Does](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/channel-manager.html): A channel manager syncs your rooms across all OTAs in real time: no more double bookings or manual updates. See how it works and what it costs for Indian hotels.
- [Hotel Accounting Software India: GST & Reports](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/hotel-accounting-software.html): Most Indian hotels use Tally for GST + their PMS for revenue. See how to manage hotel accounts correctly, reconcile OTA payments, and file GST without stress.
- [Hotel Inventory Management: Rooms Across OTAs](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/hotel-inventory-management.html): Hotel inventory isn't just stock. It's how many rooms you make available on each OTA. See how pooled inventory works and why a channel manager is the key tool.
- [Update Hotel Rates on All OTAs at Once](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/update-hotel-rates-all-otas.html): Learn how to update hotel rates on all OTAs at once using a channel manager. Sync MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Booking.com in seconds. No errors, no parity issues.
- [Hotel PMS: What It Is & Why Every Hotel Needs One](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/what-is-pms-hotel.html): A PMS runs your front desk, reservations, billing, and housekeeping from one screen. See what features matter for Indian hotels and what good PMS software costs.
- [Hotel POS System: Restaurant Billing & Room Charges](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/what-is-pos-hotel.html): A POS handles your restaurant orders, bills, and posts charges straight to the guest's room folio. See how it works and which Indian hotel POS systems are worth it.
- [Hotel RMS: Revenue Management System Explained](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/software/what-is-rms-hotel.html): An RMS watches competitor rates, demand signals, and your booking pace. Then tells you what to charge. See if small Indian hotels really need one.

## Reports

- [Hotel Reports Guides: Night Audit, P&L, Manager Report](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/): Hotel reporting guides for Indian independent hotels. Understand manager reports, night audit, arrival and departure reports, P&L, expenses, and payment reports.
- [Hotel Arrival Report: Prepare for Every Check-In](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/arrival-report.html): The arrival report lists every guest arriving today: room type, rate, special requests, VIP flags. Learn how front desk and housekeeping use it to deliver smooth check-ins.
- [Hotel Departure Report: Manage Check-Outs Smoothly](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/departure-report.html): The departure report shows who's leaving today, what they owe, and which rooms housekeeping must turn fast for new arrivals. See how to use it every morning.
- [Hotel Expenses Report: Track Costs & Margins](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/expenses-report.html): Payroll, OTA commissions, utilities, F&B cost. These 4 eat most of your revenue. See how to read a hotel expenses report and spot where the money is leaking.
- [Hotel Manager Report: How to Read Your Daily Flash](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/manager-report.html): Your daily flash report shows last night's occupancy, ARR, and RevPAR vs last year. Learn every column, what's normal, and which numbers should trigger action.
- [Hotel Night Audit: Process, Steps & Checklist](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/night-audit.html): Night audit closes your hotel's financial day: posting room charges, reconciling cash, and rolling the system to tomorrow. See exactly what happens step by step.
- [Hotel Payment Report: Cash, UPI & OTA Reconciliation](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/payment-report.html): A payment report tracks every rupee collected: cash, card, UPI, OTA settlements. See how to reconcile daily collections and catch shortfalls before they compound.
- [Hotel P&L Report: How to Read Your Profit & Loss](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/reports/profit-loss-report.html): Your P&L shows if the hotel is actually making money after all costs. See what GOP means, how Indian hotels read their P&L, and which expense lines to watch.

## Operations

- [Hotel Operations Guides: Check-In, Housekeeping, Staff Training](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/operations/): Hotel operations guides for Indian independent hoteliers. Check-in process, housekeeping SOP, cancellation policy, staff training, and FOC: all explained step by step.
- [FOC in Hotels: Free of Charge Policy Explained](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/operations/foc-hotel.html): FOC means Free of Charge: a complimentary room or service. Learn when to offer it, how to account for it correctly, and how to set an FOC policy that isn't abused.
- [Hotel Cancellation Policy for Indian Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/operations/hotel-cancellation-policy.html): Learn hotel cancellation policy types: free, non-refundable, partial refund. Set the right policy to reduce no-shows and protect revenue in India.
- [Hotel Check-In Process: Front Desk Step-by-Step](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/operations/hotel-check-in-process.html): A smooth check-in sets the whole stay. Walk through every step: ID verification, GRC, room assignment, key handover: with tips for Indian hotel front desk teams.
- [Hotel Housekeeping SOP & Checklist Guide](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/operations/hotel-housekeeping-sop.html): Complete hotel housekeeping SOP for Indian hotels. Room cleaning checklist, turnaround times, staff duties, and inspection standards to maintain guest satisfaction.
- [Hotel Staff Training Guide for Indian Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/operations/hotel-staff-training.html): Train your hotel staff the right way: front desk check-in to housekeeping SOPs. A practical guide for Indian hotel managers to build a reliable, guest-ready team.

## Compliance & Tax

- [Hotel Compliance Guides: GST, TDS, Form C for Indian Hotels](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/compliance/): Hotel compliance guides for Indian independent hoteliers. GST for hotels, TDS and TCS on OTA payments, GRC, Form C for foreign guests: all explained in plain language.
- [Form C for Hotels: Filing, Deadline & Penalties](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/compliance/form-c-hotel.html): Form C is mandatory for all foreign guests within 24 hours of check-in. How to file on the FRRO portal, deadline, exempt nationalities, and penalties.
- [GRC & Form C for Hotels: Guest Registration Guide](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/compliance/grc-form-c.html): Every hotel must collect a GRC from every guest: including Indian nationals. See what to record, how to handle Form C for foreign guests, and penalty risks.
- [GST for Hotels in India: Rates, Slabs & Filing](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/compliance/gst-hotels.html): Rooms up to ₹7,500 = 5% GST (no ITC). Above ₹7,500 = 18% with ITC. Rates effective 22 September 2025. Full breakdown, ITC rules and filing checklist for Indian hotels.
- [TDS & TCS for Hotels: OTA Deductions Explained](https://www.onlinehotelier.com/guides/compliance/tds-tcs.html): OTAs deduct 1% TCS from your payouts. Corporate clients deduct 10% TDS on accommodation bills. Know how to claim it back and avoid double taxation.
